globalHollowRules: The Hollow corrupts terrain, objectives, enemy behavior, and victory pressure.
The Hollow never becomes playable, recruitable, allied, or faction-equivalent.
Hollow incursion may appear in any battlefield as pressure, not as a realm culture.
